literal: On jichou day the imperial carriage for the first time plowed the sacred field south of the capital.
idiomatic: On jichou day the imperial carriage for the first time plowed the sacred field south of the capital.

literal: In the third month, on wuchen day, the rear palaces were rebuilt; the emperor visited Yongxing Garden and moved his residence to Xu'an Hall.
idiomatic: In the third month, on wuchen day, the rear palaces were rebuilt; the emperor visited Yongxing Garden and moved his residence to Xu'an Hall.

literal: The state of Tuyuhun sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: The state of Tuyuhun sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on xuxu day, Lady Feng was installed as empress.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xuxu day, Lady Feng was installed as empress.

literal: That month Xiao Ze's General Who Subdues Barbarians and director of the straight guard, the Man chieftain Tian Yizong, led more than four thousand households of his tribe to submit inward.
idiomatic: That month Tian Yizong, a Man chieftain serving Xiao Ze as general who subdues barbarians and director of the straight guard, led more than four thousand households of his tribe to submit inward.

literal: In the fifth month, on yimao day, Dangchang, Yinping, Khitan, Kumo Xi, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yimao day, Dangchang, Yinping, Khitan, Kumo Xi, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: On renxu day descendants of the four temples were feasted in Xu'an Hall; the emperor personally matched them in age and performed family rites.
idiomatic: On renxu day the emperor feasted descendants of the four temples in Xu'an Hall, personally matched them in age, and performed family rites.

literal: On jiazi day the emperor attended the Audience Hall, summoned the Three Dukes and all below, decided doubtful policies, and reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the emperor attended the Audience Hall, summoned officials from the Three Dukes down, decided doubtful policies, and reviewed prisoners.

literal: On dingchou day, because of drought, meals were withdrawn.
idiomatic: On dingchou day, because of drought, the emperor withdrew his meals.

literal: The Man chieftains of Xiangyang, Lei Posi and others, led more than thirteen hundred households to move inward and settle on the Taihe River.
idiomatic: Lei Posi and other Man chieftains of Xiangyang led more than thirteen hundred households to move inward and settle on the Taihe River.

literal: In the sixth month, on bingxu day, as the emperor was about to campaign south, an edict ordered bridges built across the river.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingxu day, as the emperor prepared a southern campaign, an edict ordered bridges built across the river.

literal: On jichou day an edict exempted military grain levies in Xu, Southern Yu, Shaan, Qi, Eastern Xu, Luo, and Yu—the seven provinces.
idiomatic: On jichou day an edict exempted military grain levies in Xu, Southern Yu, Shaan, Qi, Eastern Xu, Luo, and Yu—the seven provinces.

literal: On dingwei day martial exercises were held.
idiomatic: On dingwei day martial exercises were held.

literal: On yisi day an edict said: "The six duties are complete in the Zhou classics, the nine ranks shine in Han and Jin—each office must have constancy and men must keep their posts.
idiomatic: On yisi day an edict said, "The six duties are complete in the Zhou classics and the nine ranks shine in Han and Jin; each office must have constancy and men must keep their posts.

literal: Recently, though the hundred ranks have been set forth, the statutes of affairs have not been ordered.
idiomatic: Recently, though the hundred ranks have been set forth, the statutes of affairs have not been ordered.

literal: Since the Eight Yuan took their posts, We have personally reviewed them; drawing on past registers far and near and precedents of the time, We have made the Statutes of Offices and Ranks in twenty-one scrolls.
idiomatic: Since the Eight Yuan took their posts, the emperor had personally reviewed them; drawing on distant registers and near precedents of the time, he made the Statutes of Offices and Ranks in twenty-one scrolls.

literal: Affairs pressed by the military season—it is not yet thoroughly complete.
idiomatic: Affairs pressed by the military season, and the work was not yet thoroughly complete.

literal: Though it cannot regulate ten thousand measures and endure forever, it can for now clear present obstructions and put current affairs in order.
idiomatic: Though it could not yet regulate ten thousand measures and endure forever, it could clear present obstructions and put current affairs in order.

literal: We must wait until the armies return and discuss what is lacking; for the time being it may be issued for use outside the palace.
idiomatic: He would wait until the armies returned to discuss what was lacking; for the time being it might be issued for use outside the palace.

literal: Where those in charge have doubts and the statutes do not record them, report the matter as it arises; it will be added later.
idiomatic: Where those in charge had doubts and the statutes did not record them, they were to report the matter as it arose; it would be added later.

literal: " Prince Xu was installed as crown prince.
idiomatic: Prince Xu was installed as crown prince.

literal: On wushen day Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: On wushen day Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on guichou day, because the crown prince was installed, an edict granted those who had adopted heirs one rank of nobility, as gongshi;
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guichou day, because the crown prince was installed, an edict granted those who had adopted heirs one rank of nobility, as gongshi;

literal: those who had once been clerks two ranks, as shangzao;
idiomatic: those who had once been clerks two ranks, as shangzao;

literal: widowers, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves received five hu of grain per person.
idiomatic: widowers, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves received five hu of grain per person.

literal: On wuwu day martial law was proclaimed within and without.
idiomatic: On wuwu day martial law was proclaimed within and without.

literal: That month Xiao Ze died; his grandson Zhaoye usurped the throne.
idiomatic: That month Xiao Ze died; his grandson Zhaoye usurped the throne.

literal: On yiyou day the Three Elders, Duke of Shanyang commandery Wei Yuan, died.
idiomatic: On yiyou day Wei Yuan, Three Elders and Duke of Shanyang commandery, died.

literal: On bingxu day the imperial carriage performed a border sacrifice to the Supreme Lord, then went to Wei Yuan's mourning.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the imperial carriage performed a border sacrifice to the Supreme Lord, then went to Wei Yuan's mourning.

literal: On dinghai day the emperor took leave at Yonggu Tomb.
idiomatic: On dinghai day the emperor took leave at Yonggu Tomb.

literal: On jichou day the imperial carriage departed the capital on a southern campaign—infantry and cavalry over a million.
idiomatic: On jichou day the imperial carriage departed the capital on a southern campaign—more than a million infantry and cavalry.

literal: Grand Commandant Pi memorialized asking that palace women accompany the army. An edict said: "On campaign one does not discuss inner affairs—stop this request.
idiomatic: Grand Commandant Pi memorialized asking that palace women accompany the army. An edict said, "On campaign one does not discuss inner affairs—stop this request.

literal: " On renyin day the imperial carriage reached Si Province; those among the people aged seventy and above were granted one rank of nobility.
idiomatic: On renyin day the imperial carriage reached Si Province; people aged seventy and above were granted one rank of nobility.

literal: Wherever the route met the blind or lame, the carriage halted and the emperor asked in person, granting clothing and food for life.
idiomatic: Wherever the route met the blind or lame, the carriage halted and the emperor asked in person, granting clothing and food for life.

literal: On wushen day he visited Bing Province.
idiomatic: On wushen day he visited Bing Province.

literal: He personally saw the aged and asked their hardships.
idiomatic: He personally saw the aged and asked their hardships.

literal: On renzi day an edict made Acting Extramural Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Gao Cong and Acting Extramural Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Jia Zhen envoys to Xiao Zhaoye.
idiomatic: On renzi day an edict made Gao Cong, acting extramural palace attendant of scattered cavalry, and Jia Zhen, acting extramural palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoys to Xiao Zhaoye.

literal: On dingsi day an edict that wherever the imperial carriage passed and autumn grain was injured, five hu per mu were given.
idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict ordered that wherever the imperial carriage passed and autumn grain was injured, five hu per mu were given.

literal: On wuchen day the river was crossed.
idiomatic: On wuchen day the river was crossed.

literal: An edict to the people of Luo, Huai, Bing, and Si—the four provinces the route passed through: those a hundred years and older were given acting county magistrate; those ninety and older three ranks of nobility; eighty and older two ranks; seventy and older one rank;
idiomatic: An edict to the people of Luo, Huai, Bing, and Si—the four provinces the route passed through: those a hundred years and older were given acting county magistrate; those ninety and older three ranks of nobility; eighty and older two ranks; seventy and older one rank;

literal: widowers, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves received five hu of grain and two bolts of silk per person;
idiomatic: widowers, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves received five hu of grain and two bolts of silk per person;

literal: those of filial piety, brotherly duty, integrity, and righteousness, and those with civil or military talent sought by the state, were all to be reported by name.
idiomatic: those of filial piety, brotherly duty, integrity, and righteousness, and those with civil or military talent sought by the state, were all to be reported by name.

literal: Further, an edict that households of menials might not marry commoners;
idiomatic: Further, an edict forbade households of menials to marry commoners;

literal: those with civil or military talent and accumulated merit due for advancement were, by the same rule as common clans, permitted.
idiomatic: those with civil or military talent and accumulated merit due for advancement were, by the same rule as common clans, permitted to do so.

literal: On gengwu day he visited Luoyang and toured the foundations of the old palaces.
idiomatic: On gengwu day he visited Luoyang and toured the foundations of the old palaces.

literal: The emperor looked back at his attendants and said: "Jin virtue was not cultivated, and the ancestral sacrifices fell early; ruined to this point—it wounds Our heart.
idiomatic: The emperor looked back at his attendants and said, "Jin virtue was not cultivated, and the ancestral sacrifices fell early; ruined to this point—it wounds my heart.

literal: " He then recited the Millet Sorrow poem and wept.
idiomatic: He then recited the Millet Sorrow poem and wept.

literal: On renshen day he viewed the Luo Bridge, visited the Imperial Academy, and viewed the stone classics.
idiomatic: On renshen day he viewed the Luo Bridge, visited the Imperial Academy, and viewed the stone classics.

literal: On yihai day the King of Dengzhi Xiang Shupeng sent his son Jiu to the court with tribute and a memorial asking to transfer his position to Jiu; the edict approved.
idiomatic: On yihai day Xiang Shupeng, King of Dengzhi, sent his son Jiu to court with tribute and a memorial asking to transfer his position to Jiu; the edict approved.

literal: On bingzi day an edict ordered the Six Armies to set out.
idiomatic: On bingzi day an edict ordered the Six Armies to set out.

literal: On dingchou day, in martial garb holding the whip, he mounted his horse and went forth; the officials bowed before the horse and begged him to halt the southern campaign, and the emperor then stopped.
idiomatic: On dingchou day, in martial garb holding the whip, he mounted his horse and went forth; officials bowed before the horse and begged him to halt the southern campaign, and the emperor then stopped.

literal: He then settled the plan to move the capital.
idiomatic: He then settled the plan to move the capital.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuyin day, the new moon, he visited Jintong city.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuyin day, the new moon, he visited Jintong city.

literal: An edict summoned Minister of Works Mu Liang, Masters of Writing Li Chong, and Chief Architect Dong Jue to begin Luoyang.
idiomatic: An edict summoned Mu Liang, minister of works, Li Chong, master of writing, and Dong Jue, chief architect, to begin Luoyang.

literal: On jimao day he visited Henan city.
idiomatic: On jimao day he visited Henan city.

literal: On yiyou day he visited Yu Province.
idiomatic: On yiyou day he visited Yu Province.

literal: On guisi day he halted at Shiji.
idiomatic: On guisi day he halted at Shiji.

literal: On yiwei day martial law was lifted; an altar was set east of Huatai city and the traveling temple was told of the intent to move the capital.
idiomatic: On yiwei day martial law was lifted; an altar was set east of Huatai city and the traveling temple was told of the intent to move the capital.

literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: Huatai palace was raised.
idiomatic: Huatai palace was raised.

literal: Further, an edict that in the capital and all provinces those who followed the army were granted one rank of nobility; recruits two ranks; commanders three ranks.
idiomatic: Further, an edict granted one rank of nobility in the capital and all provinces to those who followed the army; recruits received two ranks; commanders three ranks.

literal: On guimao day he visited Ye city.
idiomatic: On guimao day he visited Ye city.

literal: On yisi day an edict ordered Prince of Anding Xiu to lead attendant officials to welcome the households from the Dai capital; the imperial carriage saw them off on the Zhang River.
idiomatic: On yisi day an edict ordered Xiu, Prince of Anding, to lead attendant officials to welcome the households from the Dai capital; the imperial carriage saw them off on the Zhang River.

literal: Earlier, when the emperor campaigned south, palaces were raised west of Ye;
idiomatic: Earlier, when the emperor campaigned south, palaces were raised west of Ye;

literal: In the eleventh month, on guihai day, the palace was completed and he moved his residence there.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guihai day, the palace was completed and he moved his residence there.

literal: In the twelfth month, on wuyin day, he inspected the Six Armies.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuyin day, he inspected the Six Armies.

literal: On gengyin day the state of Yinping sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the state of Yinping sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On yiwei day an edict to show compassion to soldiers—death, illness, and wounds were to be generously provided for.
idiomatic: On yiwei day an edict ordered generous provision for soldiers who died, fell ill, or were wounded.

literal: In the eighteenth year, spring, first month, on dingwei day, the new moon, he held court for the officials at Chengluan Hall in Ye palace.
idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, spring, first month, on dingwei day, the new moon, he held court for officials at Chengluan Hall in Ye palace.

literal: On dingsi day Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: On dingsi day Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: On guihai day the imperial carriage toured south.
idiomatic: On guihai day the imperial carriage toured south.

literal: An edict to Xiang, Yan, and Yu—the three provinces: those a hundred years and older were given acting county magistrate; ninety and older two ranks of nobility; seventy and older one rank;
idiomatic: An edict to Xiang, Yan, and Yu—the three provinces: those a hundred years and older were given acting county magistrate; ninety and older two ranks of nobility; seventy and older one rank;

literal: the solitary elderly, widowers, and orphans who could not support themselves were given five shi of grain and two bolts of silk;
idiomatic: the solitary elderly, widowers, and orphans who could not support themselves were given five shi of grain and two bolts of silk;

literal: those of filial piety, brotherly duty, integrity, and righteousness, and those with civil or military talent sought by the state, were all to be reported by name.
idiomatic: those of filial piety, brotherly duty, integrity, and righteousness, and those with civil or military talent sought by the state, were all to be reported by name.

literal: On wuchen day he passed the tomb of Yin of Shang Bi Gan and sacrificed with the great offering.
idiomatic: On wuchen day he passed the tomb of Bi Gan of Shang and sacrificed with the great offering.

literal: On yihai day he visited the Western Palace at Luoyang.
idiomatic: On yihai day he visited the Western Palace at Luoyang.

literal: In the second month, on yichou day, he traveled to Heyin and planned the site for the square mound altar.
idiomatic: In the second month, on yichou day, he traveled to Heyin and planned the site for the square mound altar.

literal: On bingshen day Prince of Henan Gan was transferred to enfeoffment as Prince of Zhao commandery; Prince of Yingchuan Yong was transferred to enfeoffment as Prince of Gaoyang.
idiomatic: On bingshen day Gan, Prince of Henan, was transferred to enfeoffment as Prince of Zhao commandery; Yong, Prince of Yingchuan, was transferred to enfeoffment as Prince of Gaoyang.

literal: On renyin day the imperial carriage toured north.
idiomatic: On renyin day the imperial carriage toured north.

literal: On guimao day the river was crossed.
idiomatic: On guimao day the river was crossed.

literal: Xiao Zhaoye sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Xiao Zhaoye sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jiachen day an edict announced to the realm the intent to move the capital.
idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict announced to the realm the intent to move the capital.

literal: In the intercalary month, on guihai day, he halted south of Gouzhu Pass; the crown prince attended at Puchi.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on guihai day, he halted south of Gouzhu Pass; the crown prince attended at Puchi.

literal: On renshen day he reached Pingcheng palace.
idiomatic: On renshen day he reached Pingcheng palace.

literal: On guiyou day he attended the Audience Hall and assigned who would move and who would remain.
idiomatic: On guiyou day he attended the Audience Hall and assigned who would move and who would remain.

literal: On jiaxu day he visited Yonggu Tomb.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day he visited Yonggu Tomb.

literal: In the third month, on gengchen day, the western suburb sacrifice to Heaven was abolished.
idiomatic: In the third month, on gengchen day, the western suburb sacrifice to Heaven was abolished.

literal: On renchen day the emperor attended the Grand Ultimate Hall and instructed the officials remaining in Dai on the outline of the migration.
idiomatic: On renchen day the emperor attended the Grand Ultimate Hall and instructed officials remaining in Dai on the outline of the migration.

literal: In the fifth month of summer, on yihai day, an edict abolished the fifth-day-of-the-fifth-month and seventh-day-of-the-seventh-month feasts.
idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on yihai day, an edict abolished the fifth-day-of-the-fifth-month and seventh-day-of-the-seventh-month feasts.

literal: In the sixth month, on jisi day, an edict made Acting Extramural Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Lu Chang and Acting Extramural Vice Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Wang Qingshi envoys to Xiao Zhaoye.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jisi day, an edict made Lu Chang, acting extramural palace attendant of scattered cavalry, and Wang Qingshi, acting extramural vice attendant of scattered cavalry, envoys to Xiao Zhaoye.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yihai day, Liu Chang of Song was made Grand General.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yihai day, Liu Chang of Song was made grand general.

literal: On renwu day Attendant-in-Ordinary, Grand Marshal, Prince of Anding Xiu died.
idiomatic: On renwu day Xiu, attendant-in-ordinary, grand marshal, and Prince of Anding, died.

literal: On xinmao day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On renchen day the imperial carriage toured north.
idiomatic: On renchen day the imperial carriage toured north.

literal: On wuxu day he visited Jinling.
idiomatic: On wuxu day he visited Jinling.

literal: On xinchou day he visited Shuozhou.
idiomatic: On xinchou day he visited Shuozhou.

literal: That month the island Yi Xiao Luan killed his lord Xiao Zhaoye and installed Zhaoye's younger brother Zhaowen.
idiomatic: That month the island Yi Xiao Luan killed his lord Xiao Zhaoye and installed Zhaoye's younger brother Zhaowen.

literal: In the eighth month, on guimao day, the crown prince attended at the traveling palace.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guimao day, the crown prince attended at the traveling palace.

literal: On jiachen day he traveled to Yinshan and viewed Yunchuan.
idiomatic: On jiachen day he traveled to Yinshan and viewed Yunchuan.

literal: On dingwei day he visited the Military Review Terrace and watched martial exercises.
idiomatic: On dingwei day he visited the Military Review Terrace and watched martial exercises.
